gradient.nominal: Frozen policy at replayed anchor; hold its clipped action for the entire short horizon. Never use future real states/actions for optimization.
gradient.direction: Gradient of undiscounted original reward sum, normalized by maximum absolute component; one proposal only, projected to original action limits.
gradient.noise_rule: Inconclusive if absolute mean true change <= max(1e-6, baseline full return range, baseline half-range + direction half-range). No removal of inconclusive or adverse cases.
gradient.termination: Run fixed 1/4 steps unless nonfinite; retain original termination flags and report them. These are short-horizon reward probes, not task successes.
